gates.unit: node --test tests/battle-south.test.mjs, tests/south-map.test.mjs, tests/battle-view-south.test.mjs: the named test and no other

unit.name: a recall reaches a man already in the fight, or dead or taken before the word
unit.expect: nobody can be sent for once the fight begins, and the refusal says nothing of what became of them
failed: nobody can be sent for once the fight begins, and the refusal says nothing of what became of them

unit.name: a man's fate lands the moment the fight is armed, not at its staged moment
unit.expect: each man's fate is the roll it always was, lands at its own moment inside the fight, and is on no screen and in no report before
failed: each man's fate is the roll it always was, lands at its own moment inside the fight, and is on no screen and in no report before

unit.name: a man's fate is sent to his family's page before it happens
unit.expect: each man's fate is the roll it always was, lands at its own moment inside the fight, and is on no screen and in no report before
failed: each man's fate is the roll it always was, lands at its own moment inside the fight, and is on no screen and in no report before

unit.name: Agua Dulce kept at six in the morning
unit.expect: San Patricio is fought at three in the morning of February 27, Agua Dulce at half past ten on March 2, and the day never moves
failed: San Patricio is fought at three in the morning of February 27, Agua Dulce at half past ten on March 2, and the day never moves

unit.name: the men are put in the force only after the first shot
unit.expect: a man sent south is at San Patricio, and in the force before the first shot, or rides with Grant and drives the horses north
failed: a man sent south is at San Patricio, and in the force before the first shot, or rides with Grant and drives the horses north

unit.name: every family is sent the fight, whether it has a man there or not
unit.expect: the Host sees each fight live and is framed on it; a family with a man there sees it and is alerted; a family with nobody there is sent nothing
failed: the Host sees each fight live and is framed on it; a family with a man there sees it and is alerted; a family with nobody there is sent nothing

unit.name: the account does not say why it ended as it did
unit.expect: afterwards the escaped ride for Goliad and the prisoners are marched south; at the word each family is told in plain words, and nobody else
failed: afterwards the escaped ride for Goliad and the prisoners are marched south; at the word each family is told in plain words, and nobody else

unit.name: a man is sent south who could never reach San Patricio before the raid
unit.expect: the join is refused, in words, once a man could not reach San Patricio before the raid, and offered before
failed: the join is refused, in words, once a man could not reach San Patricio before the raid, and offered before

unit.name: the woods end at the box, so San Patricio stands on no ground
unit.expect: the land the simulation reads runs on below the box to 27.6°N, on the box's own lattice, and the box is untouched
failed: the land the simulation reads runs on below the box to 27.6°N, on the box's own lattice, and the box is untouched

unit.name: a class saved before the south is never given it
unit.expect: a class saved before the south opens with it at the save's door: added, nothing it had moved, and no save version
failed: a class saved before the south opens with it at the save's door: added, nothing it had moved, and no save version

unit.name: an old save keeps the outside road to San Patricio beside the walked one
unit.expect: a class saved before the south opens with it at the save's door: added, nothing it had moved, and no save version
failed: a class saved before the south opens with it at the save's door: added, nothing it had moved, and no save version

unit.name: a night fight drawn by day
unit.expect: a night fight is dark but for the lit windows, the fire and the flashes
failed: a night fight is dark but for the lit windows, the fire and the flashes

unit.name: the men shut in a house are drawn standing in the open
unit.expect: a side in parts is drawn part by part: men asleep lying down, men in a house unseen but firing from it, men giving up with their hands up
failed: a side in parts is drawn part by part: men asleep lying down, men in a house unseen but firing from it, men giving up with their hands up

unit.name: the fallen are carried along with their part
unit.expect: a man who falls lies where he fell while the rest of his part is marched off
failed: a man who falls lies where he fell while the rest of his part is marched off

unit.name: a family's man killed is still drawn at his work
unit.expect: a family's man is drawn in his part - asleep, in the house, giving up - and once his fate has come, in it
failed: a family's man is drawn in his part - asleep, in the house, giving up - and once his fate has come, in it

environment: Same computer: node --test, and a local classroom server with headless Chrome at 1366x768 and 1024x768.
